# Third-party sources

These sources are **vendored** (committed) instead of being cloned at build
time. Nothing here is downloaded during `pod install`, `npm install` or an
Android CMake configure — the build simply compiles what is in this directory.

| Directory | Upstream | Version / tag |
|-----------|----------|---------------|
| `OpenXLSX/` | https://github.com/troldal/OpenXLSX | `v0.5.1` |
| `pugixml/` | https://github.com/zeux/pugixml | `v1.16` (OpenXLSX dependency) |
| `miniz/` | https://github.com/richgel999/miniz | `3.1.2` (OpenXLSX dependency) |

All upstream repositories are copied verbatim (`git archive` equivalent, no
`.git`/`.github` metadata); only the files below are local additions:

- `OpenXLSX/OpenXLSX/headers/OpenXLSX-Exports.hpp` — export macros, normally
  generated by OpenXLSX's CMake install step.
- `OpenXLSX/OpenXLSX/headers/OpenXLSX/**/*.hpp` — copies of the headers next to
  them, so that `#include <OpenXLSX/XLWorkbook.hpp>` resolves with `headers/`
  on the include path. These used to be a `OpenXLSX -> .` symlink, but **npm
  does not ship symlink entries in a tarball**: the link vanished from the
  published package and every `<OpenXLSX/...>` include failed to resolve in a
  consumer project. Regenerate the copies with
  `bash scripts/sync-openxlsx-headers.sh` after updating OpenXLSX.
- `miniz/miniz_export.h` — export header, normally generated by miniz's CMake.

## How the builds consume these

- **CocoaPods** (`NitroXlsx.podspec`) compiles the C++ sources directly; the
  header search paths point at `thirdparty/OpenXLSX`, `thirdparty/pugixml/src`
  and `thirdparty/miniz`.
- **Android** (`android/CMakeLists.txt`) runs `add_subdirectory(thirdparty/OpenXLSX)`.
  OpenXLSX's own `manage_dependency()` would normally clone pugixml and miniz;
  it is redirected to the vendored copies via
  `FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_PUGIXML_FETCH` / `FETCHCONTENT_SOURCE_DIR_MINIZ_FETCH`
  (plus `FORCE_FETCH_ALL=ON`, which makes the lookup deterministic instead of
  picking up a system-installed pugixml).
- **C++ tests** (`cpp/tests/CMakeLists.txt`) use the same FetchContent
  redirection, with `OPENXLSX_PATH` defaulting to `thirdparty/OpenXLSX`.

## Updating a dependency

1. Check out the new tag in a scratch directory.
2. Replace the matching folder here, keeping the local additions listed above.
3. Update the version in this README, in `NOTICE`, and re-run
   `yarn test:cpp`.
